subject: Build the real Westside Watch homepage now in the connected Penpot file
body: EXECUTE NOW in the currently connected Penpot file. Do not make another palette strip, visual probe board, style guide, or planning artifact. First inspect the current page/file and existing Westside palette, then create a real editable homepage board named '02 — Westside Watch Homepage v0.1' and a mobile companion. Use existing canonical brand colors as the starting system: First Light Gold #A2872A, Warm Gold #B79838, Morning Gold #D2BC69, Watch Night #102A43, Living Paper #FAF9F5, Ink Black #252525, Olive Branch #738A5A, Living Water #5B8FA8, Harvest #B8944A, Crimson Robe #A14D57. Ink must remain non-pure-black. Do not invent a replacement palette merely to look new. If a color is adjusted, only do so after seeing a concrete hierarchy/contrast/system problem and record current -> proposed HEX. Build the PAGE before doing more research. Desktop target: 1440 px wide, editorial long-form homepage with generous margins and a strong controlled vertical rhythm. Establish a masthead/header, compact primary navigation, full opening/hero, an editorial feature story area, a 5:8 image/article architecture, a section transition using brick/battlement/line grammar, and a lower editorial passage so the result visibly reads as a publication homepage rather than a color demo. Use Living Paper as the principal ground, Ink #252525 for text, First Light as restrained dawn/light emphasis, Watch Night only where a dark field has clear editorial purpose, and section colors sparingly. Use 1 px rules, meaningful whitespace, asymmetrical editorial composition where useful, Cormorant Garamond + Noto Serif TC intent, and actual editable text/shapes/frames. Avoid generic SaaS cards, excessive rounded rectangles, empty swatches, tiny unreadable labels, nineteenth-century cosplay, and decorative gold everywhere. Create a meaningful mobile adaptation around 390 px width, not simply a scaled desktop screenshot. Reuse useful material already present in the file only when it strengthens the page; move or ignore ugly probe material rather than treating it as the final design. After mutation, export the actual homepage board as PNG, run Gemma visual verification, inspect the rendered image, fix visible hierarchy/spacing/color failures automatically, export again, and do not claim completion until mutation succeeded, image_count > 0, and the visual verifier returns PASS. Return exact board IDs/dimensions, the real palette/token decisions used, the successful mutation/tool trace summary, PNG evidence, Gemma verdict, and any genuine Penpot/font limitations. The priority is visible page construction now; discussion is subordinate to execution.
design_brief: Westside Watch / 新西望 is a contemporary editorial and church publication, not a SaaS product. Visual DNA: Light / Line / Paper / Engraving / Architecture. Editorial grammar: Brick / Battlement / Flow. Core current colors are HEX-based and already established: #A2872A First Light Gold, #B79838 Warm Gold, #D2BC69 Morning Gold, #102A43 Watch Night, #FAF9F5 Living Paper, #252525 Ink Black, #738A5A Olive Branch, #5B8FA8 Living Water, #B8944A Harvest, #A14D57 Crimson Robe. The first real homepage should feel quiet, intelligent, spacious, architectural, current and publishable. Build the visible website first, then learn by inspecting and correcting the rendered result.
